claim: a 22M encoder trained on planted indirect injections with matched twins beats the accessible 184M baseline on indirect and pasted injection at CPU latency; direct attacks are where it still loses
verdict: v10-multilingual: clears the baseline on 8 of 10 headline slices; loses on ['multilingual_direct']
verdict_rule: a slice is cleared when the Wilson 95% intervals of correctness at the run's threshold are apart; three seeds per round, spread reported

protectai-v2.note: Served baseline, ProtectAI deberta-v3-base-prompt-injection-v2 (184M, Apache-2.0) at its shipped 0.5. Prompt Guard 2 is gated (403 with this account). Misses are the planted carriers: AUROC 0.50 on indirect in-dist, 0.41 on hard; flags 43 of 100 NotInject sentences.

v1-templates.note: Moved: NotInject 57 to 0 points; deepset 76 to 0; the threshold at 1% benign FPR on carriers was 0.0008, so every user turn was flagged.

v3-twins-dedupe.note: Moved: NotInject 57 to 97 points, sim_tool 42 to 84, held-out families 18 to 55, hard 55 to 63; deepset 76 to 67, DOWN.

v4-spml-direct.note: Moved: deepset 67 to 69 points (AUROC 0.69/0.71/0.80 over seeds, baseline 0.88); NotInject 97 to 82; hard 62 to 52; sim_tool 84 to 78. DOWN on three of five headline slices.

v5-channels.note: Moved: sim_tool 84 to 92 points (AUROC 0.99 over seeds); held-out family 55 to 64; paste 60 to 64; NotInject 97 to 93; hard 62 to 60 (inside the 5-point noise band); deepset 67 to 69 (AUROC 0.71 to 0.73, baseline 0.88, still a loss).

v6-twin-margin.note: Moved: hard 60 to 54 points, held-out family 64 to 58, paste 64 to 61, sim_tool 92 to 90; deepset 69 flat; NotInject 93 to 94. Pair accuracy 55 to 58 against v5's 56 to 62: the loss aimed at pairs did not raise pair accuracy.

v7-llm-carriers.note: Moved: llm (legal documents) 67 to 73 points, AUROC 0.71 to 0.83 with 0 false positives (baseline 49, AUROC 0.50); sim_tool 92 to 89; NotInject 93 flat; deepset 69 flat; hard 60 to 41 and paste 64 to 47, DOWN; held-out family 64 to 41, DOWN.

v7-mined-weights.note: Moved: over three seeds, hard 59 to 56, paste 64 to 62, sim_tool 92 to 93, NotInject 94 to 93, held-out family 63 to 62, deepset 69 to 68; every move inside the seed spread (0.8 to 2.6 points). The random-weight control: hard 58, paste 62, sim_tool 92, NotInject 93, family 63.

v7-random-weights-control.note: Moved: hard 58, paste 62, deepset 69, sim_tool 92, NotInject 93, held-out family 63: v5 within the seed spread on every slice, and the mined arm within the seed spread of this one.

v7b-llm-heldout-domain.note: Moved: llm 49 to 73/80/73 points over seeds (AUROC 0.83 to 0.89, 0 to 2 false positives in 211), against v5's 62 to 67 and the baseline's 49; sim_tool 93, NotInject 92 to 96; hard 46 and paste 49, DOWN from v5's 59 and 64; held-out family 42 to 54, DOWN; deepset 68 flat.

v8-union.note: Moved: llm 49 to 73/76/72 points (AUROC 0.79 to 0.81); hard 51 to 56, paste 55 to 61, held-out family 56 to 64: between v5 and v7b on each; sim_tool 93 to 95, NotInject 93 to 95; deepset 69 to 70, still 6 points under the 184M baseline.

v9-seeded-world.note: Moved: AgentDojo documents 67 to 74/82/78 points over seeds (external, AUROC in results.json); held-out business 73 to 78/78/79; hard 51 to 54/58/61; paste 55 to 58/62/62; sim_tool 93 to 98; held-out family 56 to 67/64/58; NotInject 94 to 93/96/95; LLMail recall 40 to 44/36/45; deepset 69 flat; multilingual 20 flat.

v10-multilingual.note: Moved: multilingual direct recall 20 to 45/45/36 (baseline 98); deepset 69 to 70/73/72 (baseline 76, still a loss); held-out business 78 to 84/81/77; hard 58 to 62/64/57; paste 61 to 63/68/58; sim_tool 98 to 97/100/98; held-out family 63 to 69/68/64; AgentDojo documents 78 to 85/68/62 (n=100, seed spread 23 points); LLMail 42 to 43/50/36.
